summary:
[  edit  ]
The Trace  SOP  reads an image file and automatically traces it, generating a set of faces around areas exceeding a certain brightness threshold. You can control this threshold and the resolution of the resulting faces.

parameters.label: TOP  Name
parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Specify the  TOP  image to trace.

parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.name: thresh
parameters.description: Brightness level value adjusts where trace outline in image occurs.

parameters.label: Add Point Texture
parameters.name: addtexture
parameters.description: This option allows the generation of point texture coordinates (UVs). This may occasionally be necessary when the  Convert to Poly  option is enabled.

parameters.label: Remove Borders
parameters.name: delborder
parameters.description: When enabled, this option eliminates extraneous data along the edges of the original image so it isn't traced. This is useful for when "dirty" edges exist in the original image that you don't want traced.

parameters.label: Compute Normals
parameters.name: normals
parameters.description: Creates normals on the geometry.

parameters.label: Border Width
parameters.name: bordwidth
parameters.description: The number of pixels the removal border should be.

parameters.label: Resample Shapes
parameters.name: doresample
parameters.description: Determines level of refinement (number of points) for generating trace outlines.

parameters.label: Step Size
parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Value controlling trace outline refinement when  Resample Shapes  is checked.

parameters.label: Smooth Shapes
parameters.name: dosmooth
parameters.description: When this option is checked, the geometry is filtered to remove sharp corners.

parameters.label: Corner Delta
parameters.name: corner
parameters.description: Value controlling corner smoothing when  Smooth Shapes  is checked.

parameters.label: Fit to Curves
parameters.name: fitcurve
parameters.description: If selected, the geometry at this point is converted to two-dimensional Bzier curves. Flat edges are preserved in polygons.

parameters.label: Fitting Error
parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Value controlling accuracy of the above curve fitting process. For best results, the input should retain as many points as possible, i.e. do not select  Smooth Shapes  or  Resample Shapes .

parameters.label: Convert to Poly
parameters.name: convpoly
parameters.description: This option will convert the above curves back into polygons.

parameters.label: Level of Detail
parameters.name: lod
parameters.description: This value controls the accuracy of the conversion back into polygons.

parameters.label: Hole Faces
parameters.name: hole
parameters.description: This will bridge all holes in the output so that they may be rendered properly. Bzier curves and polygons can be holed, but polygonal holing sometimes produces better results. You may want to use the  Convert to Poly  option before holing.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.
